issues.description: The problem statement asks students to implement getters for each attribute (and tests reference public getters), but the reference solution declares some getters as private (getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents()). This visibility difference is a structural inconsistency: students and tests expect public getters, while the solution hides two of them, which may confuse students and conflict with automated tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the getters public to match the problem specification and expected tests. Specifically change the visibility of getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents() from private to public in Lecture.java so all attribute getters are public and consistent with the task description and tests.
